definitions.gloss: to tidy up, to clean up
definitions.explanation: To organize and clean a space by putting things in their proper places.
To return items to their designated storage location.
To complete or resolve a task or matter.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive). Pair: ⟦{片付|かたづ}く→片付く：02041_katazuku⟧ (intransitive, to be tidied up). Pattern: X⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{片付|かたづ}ける (tidy up X).

ASPECT: て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ indicates ongoing action or resulting state. ⟦{片付|かたづ}け→片付く：02041_katazuku⟧て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ = 'is tidying' or 'has tidied.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{片付|かたづ}ける (tidy up a room)
- ⟦{机|つくえ}→机：00762_tsukue⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{片付|かたづ}ける (clear the desk)
- ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{片付|かたづ}ける (finish/wrap up work)
- ⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{片付|かたづ}ける (settle a problem)

INTRANSITIVE PAIR: ⟦{片付|かたづ}く→片付く：02041_katazuku⟧ means 'to be tidied/settled.'
- ⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{片付|かたづ}いた→片付く：02041_katazuku⟧ (The room is tidy now.)

REGISTER: Neutral. Very common in everyday speech.
